_README: MUSIC BED LIBRARY — the manifest is the licence record, not a nicety.
`deliverable` is the load-bearing field. Every track below is a SYNTHESIZED
PLACEHOLDER generated locally with ffmpeg so the MECHANISM could be built and
certified without waiting on a licensing decision. None of them is music a
_music_pick_bed() REFUSES any track whose `deliverable` is not exactly true,
and the job then takes the honest 'no fit' note instead. That is why this can
sit in the repo behind a flag with no risk: flipping PROMPTLY_MUSIC_V1 today
delivers NO music and says so honestly, rather than shipping placeholder audio
To go live: the owner picks the licensed library, the tracks land here, and
each gains `deliverable: true` WITH its `licence` filled in. Setting
deliverable:true on a track with a placeholder licence is the one edit that
would make this unsafe — the deploy gate asserts against it.
